title: The Spy Who Loved Me
tagline: Pyramids, Sardinia and a table under the sea.
about: Bond teams up with a Soviet agent to find out who is stealing nuclear submarines.
cue: Serve the snacks when Bond visits Sheikh Hosein in his tent in the Egyptian desert.
faces: Atlantis, Off the Coast of Sardinia. Pyramids, Sardinia and a table under the sea.
I. The Union Jack parachute off the ski jump.
II. Jaws and his steel teeth.
III. The white sports car that drives into the sea.
Sit, Mr. Bond. Everything at my table comes from the sea or from Sardinia, and the fish are always watching.
Green Egyptian broad bean falafel with herbs and sesame, with tahini lemon sauce and warm pita.
Spiced lamb kofta on skewers, chargrilled, with cucumber and mint yoghurt.
Sardinian toasted pasta pearls cooked in saffron broth with clams, cherry tomatoes.
The island's feast, crackling and potatoes, served at Atlantis.
Sardinian fried pastry pockets filled with molten lemon-scented cheese, drenched in warm honey.
Sardinian myrtle berry liqueur topped with sparkling wine and soda over ice.
Bond orders it for Anya, to show he's read her file.
At table: The Liparus supertanker swallowing submarines. Form BF 007. Poster and stills: TMDB.
Atlantis Dining Room, laid for tonight

    StartersSheikh Hosein's tent ta'ameyaGreen Egyptian broad bean falafel with herbs and sesame, with tahini lemon sauce and warm pitaHow to make it250g dried split broad beans (fava)1 small onion, quartered3 garlic cloves1 bunch coriander1 bunch parsley2 spring onions1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp ground coriander1/2 tsp chilli flakes1 tsp salt1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda3 tbsp sesame seeds750ml vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp tahini1 lemon, juiced4 tbsp water4 pita breadsSoak the broad beans in plenty of cold water overnight.Drain well and blitz with the onion, garlic, coriander, parsley, spring onions, cumin, ground coriander, chilli and most of the salt to a coarse green paste. Chill for 30 minutes.Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, water and the last of the salt until smooth.Stir the bicarb into the paste, shape into 20 small flat patties and press the tops into the sesame seeds.Heat the oil to 175°C in a deep heavy pan.Fry in batches for about 4 minutes, turning, until deep green inside and crisp outside.Warm the pita and serve with the ta'ameya and tahini sauce.Mujaba Club lamb koftaSpiced lamb kofta on skewers, chargrilled, with cucumber and mint yoghurtHow to make it12 bamboo skewers500g lamb mince1 small onion, grated2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp parsley, chopped1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp sweet paprika1/2 tsp ground cinnamon1/2 tsp ground allspice1 tsp salt1/4 tsp black pepper1 tbsp olive oil200g Greek yoghurt1/2 Lebanese cucumber, grated1 tbsp mint, choppedSoak the skewers in water for 30 minutes.Knead the lamb with the onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, allspice, salt and pepper for 2 minutes.Divide into 12 and mould each into a long sausage around a skewer.Chill for 20 minutes.Squeeze the cucumber dry and mix with the yoghurt and mint.Brush the kofta with the oil and cook on a hot chargrill pan or barbecue for 8 minutes, turning, until browned and just cooked.Serve with the yoghurt.MainsStromberg's Sardinian fregola with clamsSardinian toasted pasta pearls cooked in saffron broth with clams, cherry tomatoes, chilli and parsleyHow to make it1kg clams (vongole)800ml fish stocksaffron threads, a pinch4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil3 garlic cloves, sliced1 small red chilli, chopped250g cherry tomatoes, halved300g fregola or pearl couscous2 tbsp parsley, chopped1 lemon, zestedsalt and pepper, to tasteSoak the clams in cold salted water for 30 minutes to purge any sand, then drain.Heat the stock with the saffron and keep it hot.Fry the garlic and chilli in 3 tbsp of the oil for a minute, then add the tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes until collapsing.Add the fregola and toast for 2 minutes, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 12 minutes until just tender.Add the clams, cover and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until opened. Throw out any that stay shut.Stir in the parsley, lemon zest and the rest of the oil and season.Rest for 2 minutes and serve in warm bowls.Sardinian roast pork with rosemaryThe island's feast, crackling and potatoes, served at AtlantisHow to make it1.5kg boneless pork shoulder, skin scored1 tbsp fennel seeds4 garlic cloves1 small bunch rosemary3 tbsp olive oil1kg potatoes, cut in chunks1 lemonPound the fennel seeds, garlic, rosemary leaves and salt with a little oil and rub into the meat, not the skin. Salt the skin well.Roast at 240°C until the skin starts to blister.Turn the oven to 170°C, add the potatoes tossed in oil around the pork and roast until tender.Rest the pork, then carve with the crackling and serve with the potatoes and lemon.SweetsCosta Smeralda seadas with honeySardinian fried pastry pockets filled with molten lemon-scented cheese, drenched in warm honeyHow to make it250g plain flour, plus extra for rolling40g butter, softenedsalt, a pinch110ml warm water200g fior di latte, torn and squeezed dry50g pecorino, grated1 lemon, zested750ml vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp honeyKnead the flour, butter, salt and warm water to a smooth dough, wrap and rest for 30 minutes.Mix the fior di latte, pecorino and lemon zest and press into 4 flat discs.Roll the dough thin on a floured bench and cut 8 rounds of 12cm. Sandwich each cheese disc between two rounds, press out the air and seal the edges well with a fork.Heat the oil to 175°C in a wide deep pan.Fry 2 at a time for about 3 minutes a side until blistered and golden, then drain.Warm the honey, pour over the hot seadas and serve straight away.DrinksAtlantis myrtle spritzSardinian myrtle berry liqueur topped with sparkling wine and soda over ice, with lemon peel and blueberriesHow to make it2 cups ice120ml myrtle liqueur (mirto)480ml dry sparkling wine, chilled200ml soda water, chilled4 strips of lemon peel12 blueberriesFill 4 wine glasses with ice.Add 30ml of the myrtle liqueur to each.Top with the sparkling wine, then a splash of soda.Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass, drop it in and add 3 blueberries.Bacardi on the rocksBond orders it for Anya, to show he's read her file.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
